source_review.notes: Retrieved and reviewed primary join-error propagation, optimizer-evaluation, MSCN, NeuroCard, CardBench, and learned-CE readiness papers; PostgreSQL 18 row-estimation and CREATE STATISTICS documentation; current SQL Server CE and CE-feedback documentation; and current Calcite metadata interfaces. Checked model assumptions, row-goal interpretation, extended-statistics join limitation, learned estimator categories/coverage, feedback regression verification, and decision-aware evaluation limits.

evidence: Checked E/A, conditional selectivity, fanout, NDV, q-error, signed log error, intervals, OOD, and plan-regret definitions.
Checked total/per-loop/per-worker/group/batch/byte populations remain distinct.
Checked assumptions and estimator provenance accompany formulas.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Zero categories and row-goal consumption boundaries are explicit.

evidence: Recomputed 0.2 and 0.1 marginals, independence estimate 20, actual 160, and q-error 8.
Recomputed exact fanout estimate 60 versus actual 480 and ten groups.
Recomputed uniform/disjoint join, outer-join, and spill-threshold examples.
Derived the uniform containment equijoin formula from per-key frequencies.
Reviewed semantic bounds for filters, join kinds, grouping, unions, and limits.
Reviewed error preservation under exact positive fanout and why arbitrary propagation is not monotone.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Uniformity, containment, independence, and correlation extremes are models rather than SQL identities.

evidence: Reviewed empty/zero, null, heavy-hitter, out-of-range, disjoint/partial domains, duplicate fanout, outer/semi/anti/mark, group, set, recursion, and row-goal cases.
Reviewed parameter skew, cached/generic plans, stale/unsupported statistics, sample zero hits, join-crossing correlation, OOD operators/constants/shapes, model drift, inference failure, and fallback.
Reviewed template/time/database leakage, feedback censoring, tenant poisoning, label/model privacy, resource budgets, canaries, and rollback.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Fallback and unknown coverage are first-class states, not hidden predictions.

evidence: Checked every estimate binds node, population, parameters, inputs, generation, assumptions, bounds, and aggregation convention.
Checked exact facts/statistics/models/defaults obey precedence without double counting.
Checked evaluation aligns actual nodes/completion and deployment generations are immutable/rollbackable/resource-bounded.
invariant_checking.notes: Improved q-error cannot stand alone as evidence of improved plan or performance.

evidence: Reviewed uniform join derivation and correlated-marginals non-identifiability counterexample.
Reviewed outer-join matched-distinct requirement and group joint-NDV bound.
Reviewed evaluation separation from semantic correctness through plan decision and runtime outcomes.
proof_review.notes: Intervals and robust planning require calibrated coverage; no universal confidence is claimed.

evidence: The executable is labeled a finite correlated population, not a production CE benchmark.
Paper findings are scoped to their studied systems/benchmarks.
Classical formulas, learned approaches, heuristics, feedback, and operational policies are distinguished.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Product/version limitations are cited rather than generalized.

evidence: Repository verification passed one standard-library Python snippet with exact thirteen-line stdout, empty stderr, zero exit status, and recorded Python 3.14.4 toolchain.
Independent recomputation reproduced correlated, fanout, join-domain, outer-row, and threshold arithmetic.
All eleven source artifacts were retained under artifacts/references/DBE-064 and local links were checked.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No live database estimator, sample, learned model, feedback loop, alternative-plan execution, OOD detector, production workload, security test, or external review was run.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed estimated-event identity, operator formulas/bounds, correlations, join/group propagation, diagnosis, metrics, classical/sampling/learned/feedback approaches, uncertainty, parameters, and rollout.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed first-divergence diagnosis, shadow estimation, plan replay/alternatives, decision/resource metrics, OOD/fallback, immutable versions, tenant/privacy controls, canary cohorts, kill switches, and rollback.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter derives operator estimates and bounds, executes a correlated counterexample, covers fourteen failure modes and ten distinct examples, and advances five exercises to an elite CE evaluation/deployment system with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/official-source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external optimizer researcher, statistician, learned-model specialist, database maintainer, security/privacy reviewer, platform operator, or educator review is claimed. The chapter and finite model prove neither all-query CE accuracy, learned-model generalization, calibrated uncertainty, optimal plan selection, representative performance, privacy, certification, nor deployment fitness.
